title: Claudio Roditi Gemini Man CD 1988 Milestone Records Brazilian Jazz Trumpet
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Claudio Roditi - Gemini Man (Milestone Records MCD-9158-2, 1988).
Produced by Helen Keane; arranged by Claudio Roditi and Daniel Freiberg.
Recorded and remixed at Counterpoint Recording, New York City,
March 7-8 and 21-22, 1988. Mastering by George Horn, Fantasy Studios.

Claudio Roditi, trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals; Roger Kellaway, acoustic
piano; Daniel Freiberg, synthesizers; Nilson Matta, acoustic and electric
bass; Ignacio Berroa, drums; Akira Tana, drums; Rafael Cruz, percussion.

1. We (To Kristen and Me) (5:49)
2. Una Misma Alma (5:00)
3. Jacaranda (4:55)
4. Snow Samba (5:52)
5. Gemini Man (5:54)
6. Em Minas Gerais (4:40)
7. Conceicao (5:25)
8. Brazilian Roots (To Amaury Tristao) (4:07)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
